title: The Good News

slides.text: You have walked with Jesus from the Jordan River all the way to the Mount of Olives. Here is why His story is called the Good News.
God made you, and He loves you very much. He loves the whole world so much that He gave His only Son.
But every one of us has done wrong things. The Bible calls this sin, and it keeps us far from God. Jesus came looking for people who are lost, like a shepherd looking for a lost sheep.

bsb: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost.
kjv: For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.

slides.text: Jesus, God's own Son, gave His life on the cross for us, and on the third day He rose again. Because of Him, our sins can be forgiven.

bsb: The Christ will suffer and rise from the dead on the third day, and in His name repentance and forgiveness of sins will be proclaimed to all nations, beginning in Jerusalem.
kjv: Thus it is written, and thus it behoved Christ to suffer, and to rise from the dead the third day: And that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name among all nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

slides.text: Everyone who turns to Jesus and believes in Him becomes a child of God.

bsb: But to all who did receive Him, to those who believed in His name, He gave the right to become children of God
kjv: But as many as received him, to them gave he power to become the sons of God, even to them that believe on his name:

invite: Would you like to know more about following Jesus? Talk with your mom or dad, a grandparent, or a pastor. They would love to talk with you about it.
prayer: Dear Jesus, thank You for loving me. I'm sorry for the wrong things I have done. Thank You for dying on the cross for me and rising again. I want to follow You. Amen.
